decision: minblocks=4 residency hint is neutral on the raw R24 owner (0.9986x, 25/48 weights, bf16 bit-exact). At mb2 the resident capacity (192 blocks) already exceeds the 160-block grid, so every block is concurrently resident and the raw owner is per-block-MLP limited (one global fetch in flight across 192 barrier-gated K32 iterations), not occupancy limited. The remaining lever is software pipelining (prefetch next K32 tile into registers before computing the current one, one barrier per iteration).
timing: HIP events, consumer-only bursts (shared producer excluded)
